# MRXplorer

> MRXplorer offers personalized, one-on-one AI coaching for insights professionals at every level of AI comfort and fluency. Work with Z Johnson, a 2026 Insight250 winner with more than 20 years in insights. Coaching costs $1,500 USD per month, with one private 60-minute session each week and an initial three-month engagement.
